## Specific strengths
- **note-16790353135edb616b79** Consistent timeout boundary: Initialization is placed inside the same configured timeout scope already used for remote tool discovery. This keeps the two startup phases governed by a consistent, localized policy without broadening the change to unrelated gateway behavior. Evidence: [ev-6242755415fa967c616eb4a1](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/514011f8ceb8a7c0f405d13dce6b90c8199210ec/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L461), [ev-9542d02ae179455d75bad400](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L461).
- **note-1de6a20e94334fad959e** Initialization tests are included in both CI lists: The new initialization test appears in the changed test-module list and in the CI isolated-tests array. This keeps the added test aligned with the workflow's isolated test execution configuration. Evidence: [ev-02e7bfeb4ac8c7bd76628bd4](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L1), [ev-dd97145520f6173254ad0289](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L188).
- **note-330fbc0f7c5c56aedad1** Consistent phase-specific timeout boundaries: The initialization handshake and tool discovery each run under the configured connection timeout. A remote that stalls in either startup phase cannot prevent readiness indefinitely; the separate budgets avoid presenting the timeout as an end-to-end OAuth deadline. Evidence: [ev-8487f2fc01aa38cf84639db4](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/docs/MCP_SERVER.md#L1), [ev-9542d02ae179455d75bad400](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L461).
- **note-467700f5410b8ae247fb** Bounds initialization waiting: The initialization await is enclosed in an asyncio timeout using the configured connection timeout. A slow or nonresponsive upstream cannot leave startup waiting indefinitely at this phase. Evidence: [ev-9542d02ae179455d75bad400](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L461).
- **note-47459ed1b7ce25daa331** Regression covers fail-closed startup state: The test source checks that delayed initialization raises, exposes no proxy tools, clears gateway state, and leaves no named upstream owner task. These assertions address both the readiness boundary and lifecycle cleanup when the new deadline expires. Evidence: [ev-805b111e3d53da301274a2c6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/tests/test_mcp_gateway_initialization.py#L1).
- **note-746702741533b0a4dd1a** Failure-path assertions: The new test checks that delayed initialization does not publish tools or leave the gateway owner task running. These assertions cover key lifecycle consequences of a startup timeout, not just the raised error. Evidence: [ev-805b111e3d53da301274a2c6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/tests/test_mcp_gateway_initialization.py#L1), [ev-8bb999449f6bbd6f66e9fb6a](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/tests/test_mcp_gateway_initialization.py#L1).
- **note-d0848d3811b7e787f590** Exercises a delayed upstream: The added test source introduces a delayed first HTTP POST and checks that initialization fails without publishing tools or leaving the gateway owner task behind. This provides a concrete static test scenario for the startup timeout and its cleanup behavior. Evidence: [ev-805b111e3d53da301274a2c6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/tests/test_mcp_gateway_initialization.py#L1).
- **note-d36440fc991aeb6042b3** Initialization timeout regression test checks fail-closed cleanup: The test source delays the first HTTP POST and checks for the startup error, an empty proxy tool list, cleared gateway state, and absence of the upstream owner task. These assertions cover both the timeout outcome and key readiness and lifecycle invariants. Evidence: [ev-805b111e3d53da301274a2c6](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/tests/test_mcp_gateway_initialization.py#L1), [ev-8bb999449f6bbd6f66e9fb6a](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/ab8a241541ee2bc748e43443628bc6db76aaf1e8/tests/test_mcp_gateway_initialization.py#L1).
